about.title: About
about.description: Software Engineer with experience in distributed systems, microservices, and domain-driven architectures. I work with .NET, messaging systems, SQL and NoSQL databases, and Azure, leading backend development for critical systems focused on scalability, reliability, and performance.

content.title: Software Engineer III - XP Inc.
content.caption: I lead backend development for the Advisor Rotation Engine, a system that identifies and assigns the most suitable advisor to each new client. I own the engine’s backend architecture and development, with a focus on scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. I also developed QR code document submission and BACEN regulatory validation solutions for account opening.

content.title: Software Engineer II - XP Inc.
content.caption: Developed integrations between the account opening flow and credit analysis, anti-fraud, and other external services. Also contributed to building a dedicated B2B account opening experience.

content.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer - Santos Brasil
content.caption: Worked on the evolution of the terminal’s central weighbridge system and gate monitoring interface. Also contributed to rolling out the solution across other company units.

content.title: Junior Software Engineer - Santos Brasil
content.caption: Developed an RPA monitoring system and contributed to Berthwindow, a solution used in the vessel berthing process.
